text:
zoe-partnerships: Heads-up: OpenRoot sent a redistribution addendum for their 13B model. They want us to list in cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) and support bundling with our appliance SKUs. Theyre also requesting an embargoed joint announcement. Can legal/ops/hw/product highlight blockers?
michael-legal: Quick flags: any NC language prevents commercial marketplace listings. We need an explicit Redistribution Grant and Exhibit A for geo/export restrictions. Also watch for share-alike clauses.
tara-ops: Ops checklist please: signed_manifest.json, SHA256(weights.tar.gz), OpenPGP fingerprint for signature, S3 staging path + KMS policy if encrypted, allowed_regions field. We run malware scan + pre-quant tests.
liam-hw: For bundles: require firmware compatibility statement and a short export/firmware restriction line. Prefer separate SKUs for SW vs HW bundle. Hardware validation ~5 business days.
anya-product: Marketplace metadata: SKU(s), <=200 char short desc, tags (quantized/13B), model_family, latency profile, pricing tiers, owner contact, canonical README URL. We'll need distinct README for bundle.
zoe-partnerships: Provider asked for announcement week of Jul 11, embargo lift Jul 12 09:00 PT. Realistic?
anya-product: If we receive signed addendum + artifacts by Jun 25, product+ops can complete listing and QA by Jul 7. Legal needs 2 business days after final addendum. HW validation must start by Jun 28 for bundle. Tight but feasible.
michael-legal: I will draft addendum v2 with Exhibit A template and a share-alike carve-out option; will request provider to accept by Jun 20. Suggested attribution line: "Model by OpenRoot; inference served by Redwood Inference."
tara-ops: Also require provider to PGP-sign weights and include fingerprint in manifest. Entitlement token required for bundle provisioning; manifest must include allowed_regions array.
liam-hw: I'll block validation window Jun 28-Jul 2.
zoe-partnerships: Action items: 1) Zoe request signed_manifest + checksum today (due Jun 10) 2) Michael draft addendum v2 w/ Exhibit A (due Jun 18) 3) Tara draft ops ticket + entitlement flow (due Jun 22) 4) Anya prepare SKU/readme templates (due Jun 20) 5) Liam schedule HW validation (start Jun 28)
announce-bot: Note: joint-announcement draft will be created after signatures and validation pass.
zoe-partnerships: Thanks team  I'll update this thread when we have the signed_manifest and provider's acceptance.
